info.album: Come Dancing with the Kinks (The Best of the Kinks 1977-1986)

podcast.body: This keyboard-speckled nostalgic tale was a number six hit during the summer of 1983. As veterans of the first British invasion, The Kinks, still fronted by Ray Davies, demonstrated the continued relevance of established British acts. "The Kinks, yes, the veterans of the first British invasion, still fronted by Ray Davis, with their keyboard speckled nostalgic tale Come Dancing, a number six hit."
